discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and the development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology has transformed treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity, with proven cardiovascular and renal benefits; the trio received the 2024 Lasker Award and 2024 Breakthrough Prize, classic Nobel precursors, and recent prizes (mRNA 2023, microRNA 2024, peripheral immune tolerance 2025) leave metabolic medicine as a timely, high-impact field the committee has not yet honored.
